name: manual_90f432
claim: Ed25519ph and pure Ed25519 signatures are not interchangeable: the issuer events, permits and finalizations use Ed25519ph with a domain prefix, so any verifier or fixture must reproduce that exact scheme and message framing

decisions.notes: 2026-10-22: the Part 3 reference model signed with pure Ed25519 while Phylax signs Ed25519ph; the Oramasys adapter test proved the pure signature is rejected

rationale: 2026-10-22: the Part 3 reference model signed with pure Ed25519 while Phylax signs Ed25519ph; the Oramasys adapter test proved the pure signature is rejected
